newsitem.title: UK: UK Q2 firms capital expenditure falls 5.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: UK Q2 firms capital expenditure falls 5.0 pct.

text.p: UK manufacturers' spending on capital assets, including leased assets, was revised to a 5.0 percent fall in the second quarter compared with the first from a 4.0 percent fall at the provisional estimate, the Office for National Statistics said.
Manufacturers' expenditure was revised down to 2.906 billion stg in the second quarter from 2.99 billion stg at the first estimate. This compares with 3.05 billion in the first quarter.
In the latest four quarters, capital expenditure was 7.0 pct lower on the preceding four quarters compared with an initial estimate of a 5.0 percent fall.
Capital spending for other production fell by 2.0 percent in the quarter, revised from a 10 percent fall at the first estimate, while services rose by 3.0 percent, revised from a rise of 7.0 percent.
Construction investment rose by 25 percent in the quarter, revised up from 21 percent.
